CustomField.description: Identifies when Opportunity fields are restricted from updates based on the Opportunity stage.
CustomField.formula: OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Lost") )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates whether Opportunity fields are locked due to the current sales stage.
CustomField.label: Opportunity Fields Locked
